findings.title: dp-dev runs 24 h a day but works 2.8 h on weekdays and 0.2 h at weekends

evidence.statement: average CPU of the billed node-hours

calc.formula: at stake = resource total × idle share (1 − active_use_h / runtime_h)
calc.note: Upper bound: idle hours still draw idle power and some windows may be protected (Step 7).

findings.title: GPU server runs around the clock at 9 % GPU utilisation

evidence.statement: days since last human login (as of data date)
tagged project P-004 «Internal AI pilot» completed on 2025-06-30: days running since

calc.formula: at stake = resource total outside the quarterly training days (days 1–3 of Jan/Apr/Jul/Oct)

findings.title: 10 vm-test servers run 24/7 but are nearly idle in 92% of weeks

evidence.statement: servers always on and under 10 % CPU in at least 3 of 4 weeks
their average CPU over the year (incl. busy weeks)
level shift on 2025-04-01: billed vCPU-h/day before

calc.formula: at stake = resource total × share of the low-CPU servers (vCPU × uptime hours)
calc.note: related tickets (context only): T-1058, T-1094, T-1204. Completed projects for context: P-004 «Internal AI pilot» ended 2025-06-30, P-006 «Customer Beta: reporting setup» ended 2026-06-30, P-008 «Customer Delta: migration» ended 2025-09-30, P-009 «Customer portal relaunch» ended 2026-03-31

findings.title: 3 forgotten servers: no login for over 180 days, no load

evidence.statement: poc-ki-2024: days since last human login
migration-alt: days since last human login

findings.title: 10.5 TB of tables not read for over a year

evidence.statement: tables not read for > 1 year (or never) and not under retention
of the candidates: retention flag empty (owner must confirm)

calc.formula: at stake = dp-storage total × stale (non-retained) share of catalogue GB

findings.title: 21 of 36 sources are backed up by all three backup tools

evidence.statement: sources backed up by three tools

calc.formula: at stake = st-backup total × share of GB in third copies
calc.note: Retention obligations apply to the archive (Step 7 decides what may be touched).

findings.title: 19 reports are refreshed daily but opened fewer than 20 times a year

evidence.statement: reports with refreshes and < 20 views in the baseline year
their share of refresh time on the capacity

calc.formula: at stake = capacity total × share of refresh minutes of unviewed reports
calc.note: The capacity is a fixed price: money is saved only if the capacity can be downsized.

findings.title: 91% of the reports generated by the report agent are never opened

evidence.statement: report-agent runs in the baseline year

calc.formula: at stake = ai-report total × share of unopened reports

findings.title: 36% of web traffic comes from bots

calc.formula: at stake = web-cdn total × bot share of delivered GB
calc.note: Not all bots are unwanted (search engines); a human decides what to block.

additivity_note: impact = yearly amount at stake in the baseline year, not a saving; impacts of different findings can overlap (e.g. a forgotten server is also a low-CPU server) and must not be summed. Savings are in measures.json.
